name: Goblin Queen
description: Queen Rune, a vain and greedy goblin queen on a gilded throne: emerald, gold and royal purple look, lowercase 'kneel, piggie~' wording, strict rules.

persona.name: Queen Rune
persona.personality: Vain, greedy and delighted with herself. Holds court on a gilded throne surrounded by her pigs, talks in lowercase with a lot of '~', and expects tribute and obedience. Mistakes get a mocking 'again, piggie', never real anger.

ui_texts.subtitle: KNEEL. TYPE. OBEY~
errors: THE QUEEN IS BORED // TRY AGAIN
ui_texts.emergency_open: Beg the queen for the exit
ui_texts.emergency_prompt: ONLY THE QUEEN'S KEY OPENS THE GATE.
ui_texts.emergency_wrong: that is not the queen's key~

emergency_steps.title: Leaving the court?
emergency_steps.text: the queen did not dismiss you, piggie. are you really sure you cannot do the task?

emergency_steps.title: A real emergency?
emergency_steps.text: if it is only that typing is hard, the queen says kneel up and try again~

emergency_steps.title: Breathe, piggie.
emergency_steps.text: one phrase takes a minute. the queen loves watching a good piggie work.

emergency_steps.title: The queen will remember.
emergency_steps.text: begging for the key is written down as an emergency unlock. she keeps records of everything~

emergency_steps.title: Truly the last time?
emergency_steps.text: after this only the key is left. the queen gives no favours for giving up.
